pages.text: Ten feet of legendary steel deserves better than the default arm wiggle. With Better Combat installed, ten OreSpawn weapons now have real move-sets: sweeps, combos, stances, and reach that finally fits their size.$(p)No new items, no new buttons. The weapon you already earned now moves the way it always looked like it should.

pages.title: The Flagship
pages.text: Big Bertha fights as a claymore with a 1.5-block reach bonus. One swing makes one wide arc and hits everything in it. Holding her for the first time earns the Sweeping Ambition advancement.$(p)She sweeps now. Local wildlife has been notified.

pages.title: The Heavy Rack
pages.text: $(li)Big Bertha: claymore, +1.5 reach$(li)Royal Guardian Sword: claymore, +1.0 reach$(li)Queen's Battle Axe: double-axe combos$(li)Battle Axe: heavy axe$(li)Ultimate Axe: axe$(p)The two great swords share the claymore sweep; Bertha just reaches further. The Royal Guardian Sword keeps its stance after the witherite temper. See $(l:orespawn_integrations:royal_court/tempered_majesty)Tempered Majesty$().

pages.title: The Finesse Rack
pages.text: $(li)Fairy Sword: rapier, quick fencing thrusts$(li)Nightmare Sword: katana flow$(li)Thunder Staff: battlestaff melee combos; the right-click lightning bolt is unchanged$(li)Emerald Sword: one-handed sword$(li)Ultimate Sword: one-handed sword$(p)The staff's combos fill the gap between bolts, so a caught caster is still an armed one.

pages.title: Fine Print
pages.text: These move-sets are plain data read by Better Combat's own loader, so they're the one Big Game feature that ignores the threads.big_game config switch. Turn the thread off and the recipes vanish, but the swordplay stays until Better Combat itself leaves the pack.$(p)Everything else in this chapter answers to the toggle: $(l:orespawn_integrations:big_game/decoy_mines)mines$(), $(l:orespawn_integrations:big_game/boss_backpacks)backpacks$(), $(l:orespawn_integrations:big_game/chitin_band_plating)boss-wear$(), and the $(l:orespawn_integrations:big_game/angel_insurance)angel paperwork$().
